scope: First offline QA slice against S0 only; not a review of concurrent W1/W2/W3 branches
code_security_review: focused fresh-context read-only review of S0; no cross-model sign-off

blockers.finding: float(10 ** 400) raises OverflowError, which _clamp does not catch. Each structured affect field can crash the trusted admission API instead of receiving a neutral fallback.
blockers.impact: S0 has no automatic assessment producer and never sends; this is a malformed-input blocker before connecting a real assessment owner.
blockers.fix_required: Handle oversized integer conversion under a failing test and preserve finite bounds. Do not increase confidence from invalid input.

blockers.finding: Deleting the authenticated source row before admit_affect still returns true and stores a reading. Admission compares the captured turn but does not read the current source owner.
blockers.impact: Later shadow evaluation does reject the deleted source. This is an admission/delete-propagation gap, not demonstrated outbound disclosure.
blockers.fix_required: Revalidate source existence/revision and generation before assessment commit; invalidate dependent ephemeral state when source evidence is deleted or corrected.

blockers.finding: Changing presence.enabled to false during the source-owner read still permits a shadow offer and writes offered_event_id. The final current() guard checks run/Stop generation but not a revocation epoch or effective policy.
blockers.impact: S0 remains internal surface=false, and live Stop controls were explicitly deferred. This blocks promotion to delivery, not evidence that any message was sent.
blockers.fix_required: Bind revocation to the shared epoch and revalidate immediately before state commit/publication. Preserve ordinary requested replies.

remaining_release_gates: Owner fixes followed by independent recheck of these three findings
Source-pinned combined W1/W2/W3 candidate; this review does not cover their work
Full canonical regression suite and native Windows/macOS/Linux acceptance lanes
Supported distribution artifact license/NOTICE inclusion audit
Independent different-model code/security review, including this QA checker
Budget, durable restart, cross-surface claim/ACK and ambiguous-send acceptance coverage
packaging_note: Ordinary uv build --wheel is intentionally rejected by this repository. The failed attempt is not a packaging defect and did not establish license inclusion. Pinned upstream source LICENSE and NOTICE match byte-for-byte.
